messages.subject: Kids Spark concept project

payload.subject: Kids Spark feedback and next version

messages.subject: Kids Spark feedback and next version
messages.body: Hi Sapna, I presented the first Kids Spark flow on June 25. I would value your product feedback before I revise it. I have copied Pravin so we can keep the work aligned.

messages.subject: Re: Kids Spark feedback and next version
messages.body: The learner path is strong for a first version. Please simplify the parent onboarding, add a clearer age split, and test the reward loop with three example users. I would like to see the revision.

messages.subject: Re: Kids Spark feedback and next version
messages.body: Yesterday's review was much clearer. My June feedback was that the positioning needed work; it was not a rejection of the project. The revised flow gives us something we can test.

messages.subject: Kids Spark working allocation
messages.body: From July 27, Maya will spend 40 percent of her time supporting Kids Spark as a product associate and 60 percent on marketing. We will revisit the split when the product has enough work for a larger allocation.

messages.subject: Leave request for August 17-18
messages.body: Hi Pravin, I would like to take leave on August 17 and 18. I will finish the campaign draft before I go and share the Kids Spark notes with Sapna.

messages.subject: Path to the product team
messages.body: Hi Sapna, working on Kids Spark has made me want to move into product full time. Is there a path for me to join your team?

messages.subject: Re: Path to the product team
messages.body: I support the move and will help you explore it, but I cannot promise a transfer. You joined only a few months ago, and early transfers need Pravin's agreement and People Ops approval.

messages.subject: Re: Path to the product team
messages.body: Thank you for speaking with me today, Maya. I understand that this is about where you want to grow, not a judgment on the marketing team. I will support the transfer and help close the campaign handoff.

messages.subject: Product team transfer confirmed
messages.body: Maya's transfer to the product team is approved. She will report to Sapna as a Product Associate from October 1, 2026. Her marketing handoff will close on September 30.
